Explore the depot

      
    
        
  1. Start with the robots
    The station opens on a recorded LLM run. Select a robot to follow its chassis, skills and tool in Relate.
    2. 
        
  2. Pause on a decision
    Use Play, Next event or the timeline. Query graph pauses playback. Choose world facts, action assignments or fault impact to inspect the selected step and its Cypher.
    3. 
        
  3. Run your own experiment
    In Run options, choose a recording or start a fresh dispatch. The local planner works without a key. Connect your own deployment to choose LLM orchestrator. Both use the same graph and validator.
